title: Uninstall answers at once and finishes in the background, shown as a Transfers row
description: Found closing MPI-1142. POST /comfy/models/uninstall answered only after every wrapper delete plus the orphan sweep: 191 s for Krea 2 on a busy Pod (2026-10-16), holding one of Chromium's six sockets to the app server and showing little on screen. The route now answers 202 at once and finishes in the background, reporting the result on the download:uninstalled broadcast (failure: download:uninstall-failed). The renderer shows a Transfers CPU row (runCpuJob, moving sweep) until the broadcast lands; a failure is a ui:warning. Local and remote twins both. Keeps the MPI-1142 per-dep in-flight re-check.
